transform_image_edit_request: transform image edit request to OpenAI API format with multipart/form-data support for multiple images and masks
validate_environment: validate environment and inject OpenAI Bearer token authorization header from api_key or OPENAI_API_KEY secret
get_complete_url: get the complete OpenAI images edits endpoint URL from api_base or environment variables with trailing slash removal
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI image edit params including image, prompt, mask, model, n, quality, size, and timeout
map_openai_params: map OpenAI image edit optional request params to a dictionary with no transformation since inputs follow OpenAI spec
